owner: LLD-08 Infrastructure, review by product/design owner required before provider changes
auth: LOCAL_ADMIN_AUTHENTICATED_V1 supplied by LLD-12; all new reads are GET with no body or CSRF command action
read_consistency: one LLD-01 stable ReadSnapshot per request; cursor pages are fresh snapshots, not a pinned transaction across navigations
identity: canonical lowercase UUIDv4; no approximate name, serial or descriptive identity lookup
unknown_fields: reject both request and response; no transport-derived ownership

detail_queries.name: RoomDetailQuery

response.name: nonblank <=640 UTF-8 bytes / 160 graphemes
response.rack_count: integer>=0, all persisted Racks regardless lifecycle (decision pending owner sign-off)

notes: No assumed room move or site customer correction
No current Rack DTOs, occupancy layout, Cloud or network ancestry inferred

detail_queries.name: CloudDeploymentDetailQuery

response.cloud_type_id: uuid4 reference; not a physical parent
response.name: nonblank <=800 UTF-8 bytes / 200 graphemes
response.assigned_network_element_count: integer>=0, direct current assignments including archived NE (decision pending owner sign-off)

notes: Cloud Deployment scoped to Site, never physical ancestor
No Cloud assignment implied by Site membership
Archived Deployment remains readable; no mutation authority

relationship_children.name: InfrastructureRelationshipChildrenQuery

pairs.predicate: network_elements.site_id = parent AND network_element_placement_current.rack_id IS NULL with existing current placement row
pairs.link: physical_site; explicit unracked, never Cloud assignment
direct containment only; child may belong to a different Site unless a separately accepted rule says otherwise

row.label: nonblank UTF-8 <=800 bytes (rack <=640)
row.site_id: uuid4 derived from current Site owner relationship; may differ for containment child

relationship_children.sort: child UUID4 ASC (unique within given relationship and parent); no locale-dependent labels

cursor.filter_fingerprint: sha256 of canonical versioned {parent_kind,parent_id,relationship,lifecycle:null|value,limit} input; bind across pages; query/ordering shape follows LLD-01 CURSOR_V1

relationship_children.pagination: keyset; fetch limit+1, emit at most limit; no exact_total unless separately approved; first page empty does not imply other relation families are empty
relationship_children.validation: reject invalid parent-kind/relationship pairs, duplicates, forged/foreign cursors, wrong digest, unexpected keys, missing/archived parent guessing, duplicate rows and contradictory Site joins
relationship_children.integrity: Cross-Site Cloud assignment is corruption (fail whole page, do not hide invalid row); cross-Site containment is not automatically invalid under current schema. Missing current placement for an active NE is integrity error, not implicit unracked evidence.
relationship_children.performance: Use accepted FK/parent indexes; prove EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for dense parents (>=10000 children). If child_uuid ordering needs additional index, separately allocate a forward migration; never rewrite existing migrations.

reuse_existing.caveat: already explicitly bounded <=4096, not a 200-row paginated children list; do not masquerade as paginated
historical evidence is not a current entity detail

owner_choices_required: Ratify proposed all-lifecycle rack_count / assigned_network_element_count semantics (or change DTO naming to explicit filtered counts).
Confirm whether unified related-children route and four owner relation kinds are preferable to four dedicated family endpoints.
Confirm UUID4 child order and index/EXPLAIN performance gate; do not silently add unallocated indexes/migrations.
Choose error-code bindings and DTO prefixes through accepted LLD-08 types/errors/route ownership.
Confirm freshness semantics across page boundaries: per-request stable snapshot, no fictional pinned multi-page snapshot.
design_promotion_targets: global design integrity gate and revision pin update only after owner acceptance
implementation_sequence: Accept the read contract on design authority; do NOT implement endpoint based solely on this proposal.
Add focused owner query DTO/ReadSnapshot services and route adapters, no writer UnitOfWork, audit, replay, or migration unless separately allocated.
Implement Room and Cloud workbench summary read and strict fail-closed DTO validation; historical tabs use existing InfrastructureHistoryQuery.
Add lazy parent children with exact owner cursor and browser return intent, never cache owner DTO or prefetch across unfetched pages.
Run deterministic Python owner/transport tests, Node contracts, Edge 200%-zoom/keyboard/return tests, then Vite frozen source/build and security/live acceptance.
acceptance_cases: Room exact active and archived point, derived parent Site/Customer, correct revision/name/rack count
Room foreign/missing/malformed identity and unexpected DTO fields fail closed
Cloud Deployment exact active/archived, Cloud Type reference, derived Site/Customer, assignment count
Cloud Type shared across Sites never implies a common physical parent
Missing Cloud/foreign Site or corrupted cross-Site assignment fails whole read
Parent kind and relationship incompatible, invalid UUID/unknown query keys rejected before read
Room Rack list includes only direct room children, excludes sibling rooms
Site explicitly unracked NE returns only those with real null current placement; missing placement is not null
Cloud direct assignment excludes Site peers with no accepted assignment; cross-Site joins rejected
Containment direct children only; no implicit descendants or inferred same-Site child rule
Fully populated 200-item page and true next cursor; last page null cursor; no silent 200-item truncation
Stable UUID4 ordering and deterministic tie-breakers; no inconsistent or duplicated row identity
10000-child parent indexed keyset EXPLAIN/query-count bound; no O(N^2) ancestry walks
Browser Back/Forward restores only identity, filter, page cursor, focus and scroll, refetches current owner
Narrow/200%-zoom, keyboard and error/empty states; no fabricated topology or mock owner data
